title.en: Claude Fable 5 vs Fable 5.1: What Changed and How to Migrate
title.zh: Claude Fable 5 与 Fable 5.1 对比：变化与迁移方法

excerpt.en: Fable 5 has been replaced by Fable 5.1. Compare compatibility, tool-use changes, thinking-block rules, cache pricing, and the safest migration path.
excerpt.zh: Fable 5 已由 Fable 5.1 接替。本文对比兼容性、工具调用、思考区块、缓存价格，并给出稳妥的迁移顺序。

heading.en: Fable 5.1 is the current Fable release

en: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 on September 1, 2026. New integrations should use "claude-fable-5-1" rather than starting on the older "claude-fable-5" model ID.

This page now focuses on migration from Fable 5. For current setup instructions, prices, code samples, and supported platforms, use the [[guide:claude-fable-5-1-api-guide|complete Fable 5.1 API guide]].
zh: Anthropic 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日发布 Claude Fable 5.1。新项目应直接使用 "claude-fable-5-1"，不要再以旧的 "claude-fable-5" 作为初始模型。
本页现在专门说明从 Fable 5 迁移时的变化。当前的开通步骤、价格、代码示例和支持平台请查看[[guide:claude-fable-5-1-api-guide|Fable 5.1 API 完整指南]]。

en: Fable 5.1 keeps the 1-million-token context window, 128,000-token maximum output, and standard $10 input / $50 output price per million tokens. It also uses the same tokenizer as Fable 5.

Your Anthropic API key, Messages API endpoint, SDK, and basic user-message structure remain the same. In a simple integration without custom thinking or forced tool settings, the model-name change may be the only code edit required.
zh: Fable 5.1 继续提供 100 万 tokens 上下文、12.8 万 tokens 最大输出，以及每百万 tokens 输入 $10、输出 $50 的标准价格。它与 Fable 5 使用同一个 tokenizer。
Anthropic API Key、Messages API 地址、SDK 和基础消息结构也没有变化。若原来的集成没有自定义 thinking 或强制工具设置，代码层面可能只需要更换模型名称。

heading.en: Breaking changes to check before switching
heading.zh: 切换前必须检查的破坏性变更

en: Fable 5.1 always uses adaptive thinking. Requests that attempt to disable it or supply an unsupported manual thinking budget return 400. Assistant-message prefilling is also unsupported.

Forced tool choice is no longer accepted. If tool_choice is "any" or names a specific tool, the API returns 400. Use "auto" or "none" and enforce tool argument shape with strict tool use or structured outputs.

Thinking blocks require careful history handling. Earlier Claude models cannot read Fable 5.1 thinking blocks, and editing a previous turn, system message, or tool definition may invalidate them. Keep conversation history append-only and preserve returned blocks exactly.
zh: Fable 5.1 始终使用自适应思考。尝试关闭它或传入不受支持的手动 thinking budget，会得到 400；assistant message prefill 也不再受支持。
强制工具选择同样不再可用。tool_choice 如果设为 "any" 或指定某个工具，API 会返回 400。应改用 "auto" 或 "none"，并通过 strict tool use 或结构化输出限制工具参数。
Thinking blocks 对历史记录有更严格的要求。更早的 Claude 模型无法读取 Fable 5.1 的思考区块，修改之前的对话、系统消息或工具定义也可能使其失效。历史记录应只追加，并原样保留 API 返回的区块。

en: Replace forced tool choice with auto or none
Do not send Fable 5.1 thinking blocks to earlier models
zh: 将强制工具选择改为 auto 或 none
让对话历史保持只追加
不要把 Fable 5.1 thinking blocks 发送给更早的模型

heading.en: The list price is unchanged, but cache reads are cheaper
heading.zh: 标准单价没变，但缓存读取便宜了

en: Standard input and output prices remain $10 and $50 per million tokens. The important cost change is the cache-read rate: Fable 5.1 charges $0.25 per million cached input tokens. A 5-minute cache write costs $12.50 and a 1-hour write costs $20.

Anthropic estimates that typical workloads can cost about 25% less than Fable 5 after accounting for cache reads, while highly agentic workloads can save up to roughly 45%. Those are vendor estimates. Measure your own cache-hit rate and completed-task cost before using them in a budget.
zh: 标准输入和输出价格仍为 $10 与 $50/百万 tokens。成本上的主要变化来自缓存读取：Fable 5.1 读取 100 万个缓存输入 tokens 只需 $0.25；5 分钟缓存写入为 $12.50，1 小时写入为 $20。
Anthropic 估算，计入缓存读取后，常见工作负载可能比 Fable 5 便宜约 25%，高强度 Agent 工作负载最高可节省约 45%。这是厂商估算，正式做预算前仍应测量自己的缓存命中率和每项已完成任务的成本。

en: Start with a copy of production request logs that has API keys and private content removed. Identify every request that sets thinking, tool_choice, assistant prefills, or replays edited history. Update those paths before changing the default model.

Run Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 against a fixed evaluation set. Compare completed-task quality, latency, token use, cache-hit rate, tool errors, refusals, and total cost. A model can have a higher per-token price and still cost less per completed task, but that must be measured.

Roll out to a small percentage of traffic, monitor 400 errors and fallback behavior, then expand. Keep an explicit rollback path that starts a clean conversation with the older model instead of passing incompatible Fable 5.1 thinking blocks backward.
zh: 先复制一份已经删除 API Key 和隐私内容的生产请求日志，找出所有设置 thinking、tool_choice、assistant prefill，或会回放已编辑历史记录的请求路径。先改完这些地方，再切换默认模型。
用一组固定任务同时评测 Fable 5 和 Fable 5.1，比较任务完成质量、延迟、token 用量、缓存命中率、工具错误、拒绝情况和总成本。单个 token 更贵的模型有时会降低每项已完成任务的成本，但只能通过实际测试确认。
先把少量流量切到 5.1，观察 400 错误和模型回退，再逐步扩大。回滚时应开启一段干净对话，不要把 Fable 5.1 的 thinking blocks 直接交给旧模型。

question.en: Is Fable 5.1 a drop-in replacement for Fable 5?
question.zh: Fable 5.1 能直接替换 Fable 5 吗？

answer.en: Only for simple requests. Integrations using manual thinking budgets, forced tool choice, assistant prefills, or mutable conversation history need changes before migration.
answer.zh: 简单请求通常可以，但使用手动 thinking budget、强制工具选择、assistant prefill 或可修改对话历史的集成，需要先适配。

question.en: Did Fable 5.1 become more expensive than Fable 5?
question.zh: Fable 5.1 比 Fable 5 更贵吗？

answer.en: The $10 input and $50 output list prices are unchanged. Cache reads are cheaper at $0.25 per million tokens, so workloads with stable reusable prefixes may cost less overall.
answer.zh: 输入 $10、输出 $50 的标准价没有变化。缓存读取降到 $0.25/百万 tokens，因此拥有稳定可复用前缀的工作负载可能降低总成本。

question.en: Can I keep the old model as an automatic fallback?
question.zh: 可以继续把旧模型作为自动回退吗？

answer.en: Yes, but do not pass Fable 5.1 thinking blocks into an earlier model. Create a clean text summary or restart the conversation when routing backward.
answer.zh: 可以，但不能把 Fable 5.1 thinking blocks 传给更早的模型。向旧模型回退时，应创建干净的文本摘要或重新开始对话。
